description: Minimal global task-level state retained by the centralized critic after Commander deprecation.

fields.description: Whether the current suppression rules allow landing.

fields.name: landing_stage_id
fields.description: Three-level landing phase: 0 before landing is allowed, 1 landing is allowed but no army is ashore yet, 2 at least one ground unit has landed ashore.

fields.name: capture_condition
fields.description: Whether a ground objective is occupied by red ground forces with no blue ground presence.
